name: test-generator
description: Generate comprehensive tests for a module
instructions:
Generate comprehensive tests for {{module}} using {{framework}}.

Target: {{coverage_target}}% code coverage

Requirements:
1. Read the module to understand all functions, classes, and edge cases
2. Write tests covering:
   - Happy path for each public function/method
   - Edge cases (empty input, None, boundary values)
   - Error conditions (exceptions, invalid input)
   - Integration points (mocked where appropriate)
3. Use {{framework}} conventions (fixtures, parametrize, markers)
4. Tests must be runnable: pytest <test_file> should work

Write the test file alongside the module or in tests/ directory.
